review_scope: Read and solved all twenty exact prompts and complete scored answers. Every part has one semantic mapped solution and analytic credit summing to five; each domain sums to twenty.
Mapped all twelve accepted chapter outcomes to substantive tasks. The exam is cumulative and does not claim exhaustive testing of every chapter subtopic.

Verified period, currency and fee bases, external-flow timing, population versus sample covariance, explicit return-variance objective units, constrained concavity and the limited worst-mean uncertainty set.

Derived CAPM from common beliefs, same-rate unrestricted financing, SPD covariance, wealth-weighted demands and zero net safe supply. A separate compatible covariance/supply witness verifies that the supplied moments can coexist.

Kept the CAPM safe rate of two percent separate from the complete-market safe gross return of one. Checked payoff rank, positive state prices, positive physical support, SDF normalization and every replica/arbitrage cash flow.

Verified population projection normal equations and nonlinear residual dependence rather than falsely equating orthogonality with independence. Both zero-cost factors have zero SDF price; exact hedging creates a constant gain only against the inconsistent extra quote.

Enumerated all 2,048 eleven-outcome sign sequences, preserving the dependence of opposite orientations. The selection correction reverses the five-percent rejection. Frozen later evaluation does not erase earlier search or justify retuning.
Recomputed net strategy and active returns, sample tracking error and per-period IR. Interpretation retains benchmark, factor, short-sample and original-cohort limitations.

Reconstructed surplus from separate terminal assets and liabilities. Conditional optima are feasible; full four-state moments retain between-opportunity-state variance. Conditional optimization is not presented as proof for the different initial criterion.

Reconciled private gross contributions and distributions independently of annual net cash. IRR uses a positive gross root; call funding is checked before the later same-day receipt, with no pledge or borrowing. The exact minimum reserve works and a smaller reserve fails.
Reconciled actual and original paper cash, shares and marked wealth. The fixed past loss remains in the future wealth difference while its variance comes from the unmatched risky exposure.

Evaluated all 31 permitted integer repairs, identified the smallest joint cash/risk repair and distinguished temporary mandate authority from full completion. A later eighteen-share sale following the temporary twelve-share repair equals thirty total, avoiding double sale.
Checked all chapter/source routes, administration, error carry-forward, critical-error policy, unique IDs and balanced HTML. The final intraday-interest clarification changes no numerical result.
